description: Westland Project Files hook — three-rule policy on the Westland share: (1) modify-prompt on any existing file (auto-mode cannot auto-approve); (2) version-controlled types (.xer, ...) hard-denied for in-place changes (force -vN versioning); (3) delete hard-denied (move to _Archive / _to_delete instead). Files outside the share are not affected. The wrapper (run-hook.ps1) blocks (exit 2) if no real Python is on PATH so the safety rules never silently no-op.
